AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 7a-f)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Items #7a-f) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision.

Approval of Resolution R18-43; a Resolution Resolving Cross-Appeals from Planning Commission CDP-113-18; a Coastal Development Permit Application for a New Wrought Iron Fence at the Single-Family Residence Located at 2801 Via Segovia
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R18-43; resolving cross-appeals from Planning Commission CDP-113-18; a Coastal Development Permit Application for a new wrought iron fence at the single-family residence located at 2801 Via Segovia.
Staff Report
5.

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council "receive and file" the list of appointments listed herein to the Investment Policy Advisory Committee.
Staff Report
6.
Special Event Application of the Lunada Bay Homeowners Association to Hold its Annual Harvest Festival at Lunada Bay Park on October 21, 2018 and Post Signs Promoting the Event
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request of the Lunada Bay Homeowners Association to host the annual LBHOA Harvest Festival on Sunday, October 21, 2018 from 2:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. at Lunada Bay Park and the adjacent street of Via Anacapa, and posting of promotional signs at both permitted locations.

a.
M-1277-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for fencing exceeding the allowable height within the setback adjacent to the street at the single family residence located at 900 Via Nogales. Lot 14, Block 1636, Tract 7330. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Bolton Engineering Corp., 25834 Narbonne Ave #210, Lomita, CA 90717
Owner: Marilyn Radford
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions.

M-1280-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a new detached structure exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 704 Yarmouth Road. Lot 12, Block 2205, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Luis DeMoraes
27010 Springcreek Rd
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
Owner: Bill & Kim Rhodes
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) A Hollywood Berm shall be constructed, per City standards, along the frontage of the property. 2) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (walls, brick walkway, etc).
c.
M-1281-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for non-standard encroachments within the public right of way at the single family residence located at 3625 Via La Selva. Lot 15, Block 6103, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Hans Grellman
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) The property owner(s) shall execute a license agreement for non-standard encroachments.

3 Malaga Cove Plaza #202
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Owner: Mr. & Mrs. Dan Majka
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions.

NC-1630/G-1619-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading Applications for a new single family residence located at 736 Cloyden Road. Lot 14, Block 1276, Tract 7140. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Cauthen Design Inc.
25532 Narbonne Ave., #100
Lomita, CA 90717
Owner: Junru Pan & Sindy Wu
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Curb shall be constructed, per City standards, along the frontage of the property. 2) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (wall, sidewalk, bricks, etc).
f.
NC-1637-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a new deck & addition at the single family residence located at 2245 Via La Brea. Lot 17, Block 1635, Tract 7330. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Joseph Fournier Design, Inc.
362 Termino Ave
Long Beach, CA 90814
Owner: Golnaz Eslami
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (hand rails, walkway, etc). 2) New curb shall be constructed per City standards along the property frontages as approved by the City Engineer. 3) A new driveway approach shall be constructed per City standards as approved by the City Engineer. 4) Runoff from watershed tributary to the boundaries of the proposed project shall be intercepted and conveyed through the site to an approved drainage outlet/easement. 5) This project is considered Hillside Residential. Portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project shall comply with the City Ordinance and Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C.
Staff Report
